info.title: TimoxVasio Local Control API
info.description: Control contract for the local TimoxVasio audio engine. The API binds only to 127.0.0.1. HTTP exposes confirmed engine state and driver inventory; the WebSocket accepts idempotent configuration.apply commands and publishes state, routing, error and audio.meter events. Audio sample transport itself remains on the ASIO/shared-memory path and is outside this control API.

servers.description: Loopback only. The engine reports its selected port at startup.

get.summary: Read the confirmed engine state and complete routing configuration

200.description: Current engine state, inventory and routes

get.summary: Read physical ASIO and TimoxVasio driver capabilities
Read per-application ASIO channel compatibility profiles
get.description: Unlisted processes receive 256 input and output channels. The built-in Mixxx profile advertises 255 in both directions. Profiles match the executable basename case-insensitively. A running client must be restarted after its effective profile changes.

put.summary: Replace all per-application ASIO channel profiles
put.description: Replaces the complete profile list. An empty list restores the 256-channel default for every application. Existing clients whose effective channel counts changed are returned in restartRequiredClients; their current ASIO instances retain their original getChannels result until restarted.

200.description: Profiles saved and clients requiring restart identified

get.summary: Upgrade to the TimoxVasio control WebSocket
get.description: Connect with the vasio.api.v1 subprotocol. Send configuration.apply requests and receive matching responses and asynchronous events. audio.meter events are sent for endpoints in active routes at approximately two updates per second; peakDbfs is the peak of the most recently processed audio block, not a held peak. Meter publication runs outside the real-time audio callback. See x-websocket for message schemas.

ServerError.description: The local engine could not serve the request
